publication.title: Visual querying of linked data with QueryVOWL
publication.version: 2015 CEUR proceedings version; exact event imprint not established from body

source_reading.scope: All substantive sections: notation/SPARQL mappings, editing and limitations, examples, both prototypes, eight-task qualitative study and conclusions; references not read integrally.

adjudication.basis: Two implemented QueryVOWL prototypes support visual pattern construction and dynamic result inspection over RDF endpoints. Data-dependent property choices and live match counts guide refinement. The report evaluates the web prototype with six people; it does not establish comparative usability or measured latency.

codes.notes: Six-person qualitative study, not a comparative trial. Notation expressivity and implemented subsets differ; generated SPARQL is not a formal text editor. Natural-language explanations are future work.

backend.source_model_description: {"model": "RDF instances structured with RDFS/OWL", "query_language": "Automatically generated SPARQL sent to a selected endpoint", "components": ["Web: HTML/JavaScript/CSS/SVG/D3", "Desktop: C#/.NET/WPF"]}

studies.population: Three women and three men, ages22–43, median26; different non-IT professions, no prior ontology/Semantic Web experience.
studies.cohort_note: Cross-report participant overlap is not established.
studies.design: Qualitative single-interface study with introductory video, training, seven construction tasks and one comprehension task.
studies.results: Most construction tasks solved; five of six interpreted the comprehension graph easily. Confusion about class vs individual, property direction and equality representation persisted.
limitations: No comparator, complete task success/time table or standardized usability scale. Potential same protocol/cohort as companion QueryVOWL reports; independence not established.

descriptions.interaction: Create and edit node-link query patterns, add data-compatible properties, drag nodes, focus a query element and inspect matching resource labels/IRIs.
descriptions.guidance: Lists of properties/resources compatible with the current pattern, hover configuration controls and dynamically updated match counts/node sizes.
descriptions.visualisation: ["Node-link query diagrams", "Sidebar properties/filters", "Result lists", "Dynamic size/count annotations"]
